messages:
jessica.ops: heads up, AcmeCorp reported a failure right after we provisioned a new HSM key in their Private deployment. app requests started getting `key_not_found` / 404s about 30s after the provider API returned success. :worried:
rahul.support: ouch. do we have request IDs / timestamps? which pathway — KMS mapping or direct HSM alias?
jessica.ops: we created the key via the Console (private control plane -> Keys -> Create) at 2026-03-17T10:01:10Z. console returned success, key id `acme:kb-9a2f`. app logs show first 404 at 2026-03-17T10:01:40Z. request id in logs: `req-0a7c3f`. copy-pasting app error: `ERROR: vault: key lookup failed: key_not_found acme:kb-9a2f`
sophie.eng-runtime: can you paste the control-plane audit entry and the key-sync agent logs from the private runtime (edge node)? suspect delay in key propagation to the runtime’s local keystore cache.
jessica.ops: audit entry: `AUDIT 2026-03-17T10:01:10Z user=jessica action=create_key id=acme:kb-9a2f method=console`

hsm-operator-bot: HSM cluster event: provisioning queued on node hsm-02 at 2026-03-17T10:01:12Z, estimated backend apply 120s

rahul.support: that queued message is interesting — we've seen that when the HSM's internal provisioning pipeline gets backpressured during firmware sync. can you fetch the key-sync logs from hsm-sync-agent on the app node? command: `sudo journalctl -u hsm-sync-agent --since "2026-03-17 09:59" --until "2026-03-17 10:05"`

jessica.ops: pasted output snippet:
```
Mar 17 10:01:12 hsm-sync-agent[2345]: INFO starting sync for key acme:kb-9a2f
Mar 17 10:01:13 hsm-sync-agent[2345]: WARN backend queue depth=12 threshold=10
Mar 17 10:02:45 hsm-sync-agent[2345]: ERROR failed to fetch key metadata from HSM: timeout connecting to hsm-02:5900
Mar 17 10:03:05 hsm-sync-agent[2345]: INFO retrying provisioning, attempt=2
Mar 17 10:03:28 hsm-sync-agent[2345]: INFO key acme:kb-9a2f propagated to local keystore
```

mike.sre: that shows a ~2m propagation gap between console success and local keystore availability — maybe transient network hits to the HSM mgmt plane. can we confirm HSM node health and recent maintenance window? also need to check audit log completeness for compliance.
sophie.eng-runtime: agreed. @mike.sre can you run connectivity check and vendor health probes? sample command we use for CloudHSM: `openssl s_client -connect hsm-02:5900 -servername hsm-02` or the vendor health API `GET /health` against the mgmt plane.
mike.sre: ran quick checks: TCP connect to 5900 succeeded but TLS handshake showed `alert handshake failure` at 10:02:40Z. vendor control-plane reported scheduled firmware push at 10:00Z but status=partial. opened vendor ticket VND-5421.
rahul.support: escalated to enterprise ops: this is impacting production key availability for AcmeCorp for ~2m, need to confirm if any other keys/tenants affected and whether audit events were dropped during the window (SOC2 concern).
jessica.ops: customer asked if data could have been encrypted/decrypted during that time or if any signing requests failed silently. app logs show 403 for signing attempts while key was missing, so ops blocked requests, nothing decrypted incorrectly. still need to preserve audit trail. :lock:

hsm-operator-bot: Audit pipeline status: forwarded 153 events for 2026-03-17T10:00-10:05 window, last flush at 10:05:15Z. Some events queued when HSM mgmt was degraded.

mike.sre: next steps I recommend:
- mark incident for AcmeCorp and attach vendor ticket VND-5421
- retain raw audit events for +90 days in immutable storage (SOC2) — export current queue to S3 archive: `./tools/export_audit.sh --from 2026-03-17T09:59 --to 2026-03-17T10:06 --tenant acme --dest s3://redwood-audit-hold/acme/2026-03-17/`
- restart hsm-sync-agent on the edge node as a temporary mitigation: `sudo systemctl restart hsm-sync-agent`

sophie.eng-runtime: also adding a short-term guard in runtime: if key lookup fails for a newly-created key within 3m of create_time, return 429 instead of 404 and surface a more descriptive message to SDKs so apps can implement retry with jitter. will put a canary patch behind feature flag.

rahul.support: agreed. add to the customer reply: explain what happened, link audit archive, vendor ticket, and the mitigation steps. ask if they observed any failed requests beyond the 10:03:30Z propagation.
jessica.ops: drafting reply now. will include: timeline, vendor ticket, audit export location, mitigation (agent restart + runtime guard), and ETA for vendor fix. pinging customer for any additional logs. :memo:

mike.sre: follow-up action for compliance: run a quick integrity check on the exported audit bundle and compute SHA256, put checksum into the incident record.
sophie.eng-runtime: noted. I'll raise a post-incident to evaluate if we need to surface HSM provisioning queue depth metrics in Console per-tenant.

jessica.ops: customer replied: "thanks — the downtime was brief and we appreciate the quick escalation, please confirm when vendor resolves firmware partial push" — marking as high priority until vendor confirms. :+1:

rahul.support: marking thread resolved for support handoff but keeping incident open until vendor VND-5421 closed and audit checksum stored.
mike.sre: I'll attach the export, checksum, and vendor communication to INC-2026-0317-07. closing out Slack thread once all artifacts uploaded. :white_check_mark:
